# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan, FreeType on Nano Server, and performance fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0-unreleased brings a new Vulkan/Silk.NET package, FreeType font support on Nano Server, a memory-leak fix, and performance improvements. This unreleased build adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for GPU-accelerated rendering via the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, and enables FreeType-based font loading on Windows Nano Server containers. A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the raster-image failure path is fixed, string allocations are trimmed in GetEncodedText, and the SKRuntimeEffect uniform lookup map is pre-sized to avoid rehashing.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new NuGet package wraps the Vulkan backend using Silk.NET bindings, letting applications drive GPU-accelerated Skia rendering through the Silk.NET Vulkan abstraction layer. Vulkan tests now run on Android and Linux CI legs to validate the integration. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Windows Nano Server** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server containers, which lack the GDI font APIs. This unblocks usage in minimal Windows container deployments. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — When creating an SKImage from raw pixels failed, the CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer was not freed. The leak has been fixed, preventing unbounded native memory growth in error scenarios. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Eliminated intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText** — The null-terminated path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing per-call allocations for text encoding operations. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized at construction** — The uniform name-to-index map in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is now allocated with the exact capacity required, avoiding dictionary rehashing during shader uniform lookups. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Engine

- **Skia submodule and cgmanifest updated** — The bundled Skia engine and its cgmanifest dependency declarations have been synchronised to the latest upstream snapshot. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))
